mentions.name: DB Pro
mentions.description: DB Pro is a modern, polished database client for desktop and web that is now fully self-hostable. Its self-hosted version, Studio, has just launched, and the project is documented through an ongoing video devlog series.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building DB Pro, a modern, beautiful, and now fully self-hosted database client for desktop and web.

Just launched Studio, which is the self-hosted version of DB Pro.

mentions.name: DB Pro
mentions.description: DB Pro is a database client with newly released dashboard support. An upcoming companion service, DB Pro Cloud, will let users connect to and manage any database through the browser and collaborate with their team, positioned as 'Postman but for databases'.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building DB Pro, a better database client.

I just released support for dashboards. I've kept a devlog for the past 6 months.

https://youtu.be/EEA73e6MH1c

And the biggest update is coming soon, DB Pro Cloud, which will let you connect to and manage any database through your browser as well as collaborate with your team.

Imagine Postman but for databases.

https://dbpro.app
